summary: On September 22, 2026, Willdan Energy Solutions, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Willdan Group, Inc., entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement with Mantis NewCo, LLC (Seller) to acquire 100% of the equity of Mantis Intermediate Holdings, LLC for a base cash purchase price of $285,000,000, subject to working capital, cash, indebtedness and transaction expense adjustments. Closing is expected on October 30, 2026, or the third business day after conditions are satisfied, including HSR clearance and no prohibitive order. The filing names no advisor or board recommendation. Watch HSR timing and purchase price adjustment mechanics as risk-arb considerations.
